items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I think -- I'm not sure. I think Andy Kirk traveled like that... But I'll tell you another good recording band to me back there then was Andy Kirk.

ctx.x: Do you know whose band traveled in cars?

I think -- I'm not sure. I think Andy Kirk traveled like that. There was one of the bands that traveled -- but I know several did, back in those times, you know. If you pick up some of the old jazz books, you see some of the pictures of cars, those old cars where they were traveling in the cars, you know, some of them.
